target_customer: Home service contractors in plumbing, HVAC, electrical and related trades
problem: Contractors miss calls and leads, and follow-up on estimates and memberships is manual, so jobs are lost.
business_model: B2B SaaS and usage; pricing not public
product_category: AI voice agents and operating system for home services

founders.name: Abhishek (AJ) Jain
education: BITS Pilani, computer science (per YC page)
previous_startups: Telematica (energy management software, raised $1.5M per YC page)

founders.name: Aditya Ketkar
education: BITS Pilani, computer science (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: research at the CVC lab at UAB Barcelona.

competitors.name: Jobber
competitors.what: Management platform for home service professionals
competitors.funding_then: $60M equity round led by Summit Partners, January 2021

competitors.name: Workiz
competitors.what: Productivity and phone tools for home service teams

competitors.name: Housecall Pro
competitors.what: Software for small and midsize home services businesses
competitors.funding_then: $125M raised June 2022 (Permira, Vista Credit), a few months after the batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time voice agents booking into field service systems require speech, scheduling integrations and reliability; the team started as energy software engineers.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro and customer data create stickiness, but voice AI platforms are proliferating.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying it; the company grew to over 1,500 businesses by October 2026.

market_need_then: Home service firms depend on phone booking; the first customer Armstrong Plumbing became Chief Industry Officer. Demand evidence for 2022 specifically was not found.

branding.domain_note: Operates broccoli.com, an exact word domain; acquisition history not found

identity.mascot_or_character: Named AI agents such as Brenda, Amy and Mark
identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly and playful, food puns, tagline 'Be the name homeowners trust'

branding.brand_signature: Named AI agent personas and food puns
branding.community_and_virality: Press coverage of funding in Fortune; no merch or fan evidence

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable real word and playful agent personas in a dull trade category, but no independent evidence it drove growth.

pivots.from: Telematica, energy management for European utilities and charging operators
pivots.to: Broccoli AI for home service businesses
pivots.why: Not stated in sources opened; YC lists Telematica as the founders' earlier company

outcome_analysis: Broccoli grew from a Winter 2022 YC company into a voice AI platform for home services, with Khosla led funding reported at $25M Series A and $52M in total across A and B by October 2026, and over 1,500 businesses served. The strong timing came from voice model progress, and an early customer became an executive. Round dates and sizes are partly unclear across sources.
notes: Pulse2 (2026-10-31) and Fortune (2026-10-28) report $52M across Series A and B led by Khosla, with the rounds nine months apart; neither gives exact dates or the split. The $25M Series A figure comes from the YC page (also in a yespress profile seen only as a search snippet) and its date is unknown. The Series B amount is not stated; the date is the month it was reported. The ServiceTitan competitor source is a 2026 directory, not dated at founding, so it is weak. Founder ages not stated. Competitors come from 2021 and 2022 funding news in a dated search; none was named by Broccoli. The Jobber, Workiz and Housecall Pro sources were seen in search results only.
